correctness.rationale: For a finite symmetric positive-rate continuous-time core, pause core occupation at v to attach rate-w Poisson excursions each with independent Exp(w) holding time. Conditional compound-Poisson LT exp(-ws/(w+s) L_v) yields E(T_w)=E(T0+L_v), variance Var(T0+Lv)+2 E Lv/w. The kernels K_t Laplace exp(-zs/(1+ts)) form a mean-preserving Chapman–Kolmogorov semigroup, and Jensen yields T_{w2} <=cx T_{w1} for w2>w1. Strict second moment when P(Lv>0)>0; same means rule out first-order stochastic domination. w↓0 TV to T0 but means differ; w↑∞ L2 under common core coupling.
